metadata.description:
In this interview, Vikram Mandavi, Congress MLA from Bijapur, speaks about the ground realities of Bastar.
He discusses the ongoing Naxal conflict, recent encounters, and how innocent Adivasis are often caught in the deadly crossfire between security forces and Naxal insurgents. Mandavi provides a candid political perspective on the human cost of violence in one of India's most neglected regions.
